software.backgroundActivity: Push synchronization/notifications may use background services depending on build and settings
software.description: Cross-platform password manager with hosted and self-hosted options.

evidence.claim: Bitwarden documents zero-knowledge encryption for vault contents while distinguishing account/operational metadata.
The Bitwarden Android repository lists minimum SDK 29 (Android 10).
Bitwarden documents Firebase-related push/crash behavior and notes that its F-Droid build removes Firebase.

software.internetRequirement: Required for account creation/sync and hosted services; local access to cached vault data can work offline
limitations: Requires an account for synchronized vaults
software.name: Bitwarden
software.networkActivity: Synchronization, account access and hosted services require network access; previously available vault data can be accessed locally
software.pricing: Free and paid plans; verify current official pricing

privacyDetails.advertising: Not documented as a core password-manager use
privacyDetails.analytics: Bitwarden documentation notes Firebase crash reporting on some Android builds/settings.
privacyDetails.collected: Bitwarden distinguishes end-to-end encrypted vault contents from account and operational metadata such as account identifiers.
privacyDetails.controls: Hosted or self-hosted deployment, client settings, and export choices provide different control points.
privacyDetails.deletion: Account and vault deletion are separate from any exported local copies.
privacyDetails.encryption: Bitwarden documents end-to-end/zero-knowledge encryption for vault data.
privacyDetails.practicalImplications: Zero-knowledge encryption protects vault contents, but it should not be interpreted as zero metadata. Plaintext exports create an unencrypted copy.
privacyDetails.purpose: Provide password-manager accounts, vault synchronization, security features, support and service operation.
privacyDetails.recipients: Service providers may process operational metadata; encrypted vault contents are designed so Bitwarden cannot read them.
privacyDetails.sale: Not documented in the checked security sources
privacyDetails.sharing: Vault sharing is user-directed; service infrastructure handles encrypted vault synchronization.
privacyDetails.tracking: Distribution channel matters; the F-Droid build is documented as removing Firebase components.

software.privacySummary: Bitwarden publishes source, security documentation, and third-party audit material. Sync requires an account on a hosted or self-hosted server.
software.requirementEvidence: Bitwarden Android README compatibility section, checked 2026-09-22
